lines.zh: 骨头太多，走路像一整袋碎瓷在晃。
lines.en: Too many bones; I walk like a sack of broken porcelain.

lines.zh: 三副骨架挤在一起，谁先迈步都争吵。
lines.en: Three skeletons share me, and we argue over who steps first.

lines.zh: 我拖着肋骨走路，草把它们当琴弹。
lines.en: I drag my ribs along, and the grass plays them like strings.

lines.zh: 每一步都有骨头掉队，我不回头捡。
lines.en: A bone falls behind each step, and I never turn back.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖是别人剩下的，走起来很响。
lines.en: My knees belonged to someone else and clatter loudly.

lines.zh: 在传说维度里，我踩着灰往前走。
lines.en: In the Legend realm I walk forward over the ash.

lines.zh: 我不需要路，我只需要下一具身体。
lines.en: I need no road, only the next body to take.

lines.zh: 这双腿走得太快，脊骨跟不上。
lines.en: These legs move too fast; my spine cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 骨节咬合又松开，像一台旧机关。
lines.en: My joints lock and release like an old mechanism.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，因为跌倒会散一地。
lines.en: I walk carefully, because a fall would scatter me everywhere.

lines.zh: 别数我的步子，我自己都数不清。
lines.en: Do not count my steps; I lost track long ago.

lines.zh: 灰从我的眼眶漏出来，落在身后。
lines.en: Ash leaks from my eye sockets and falls behind me.

lines.zh: 我蹲下时，骨头自己重新排队。
lines.en: When I crouch, my bones line up on their own.

lines.zh: 没有皮肤，风直接吹进我的胸腔。
lines.en: With no skin left, wind blows straight into my chest.

lines.zh: 我数自己的骨头，每次都多出一根。
lines.en: I count my bones, and every time there is one extra.

lines.zh: 我在等一具合适的骨架空出来。
lines.en: I am waiting for a suitable skeleton to become vacant.

lines.zh: 传说维度的夜把我的关节冻住了。
lines.en: Night in the Legend realm freezes my joints stiff.

lines.zh: 我试着坐下，结果坐成了一堆。
lines.en: I tried to sit down and became a pile instead.

lines.zh: 谁的骨头在我身上，我不记得了。
lines.en: Whose bones are these on me? I no longer recall.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身体更像一个人。
lines.en: My shadow looks more like a person than I do.

lines.zh: 安静时能听见骨髓在慢慢干。
lines.en: In silence I hear the marrow slowly drying out.

lines.zh: 我在土里埋过自己，又爬了出来。
lines.en: I buried myself in the dirt once, then crawled out.

lines.zh: 你身上的骨头，数目刚好合适。
lines.en: The bones inside you are exactly the right number.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是在量你的肩宽。
lines.en: I stare at you to measure the width of your shoulders.

lines.zh: 别动，让我看看你能拆成几块。
lines.en: Hold still while I judge how many pieces you make.

lines.zh: 你的皮肉太厚，遮住了好东西。
lines.en: Your flesh is too thick; it hides the good parts.

lines.zh: 三十二格内，你藏不住。
lines.en: Within thirty-two blocks you cannot hide from me.

lines.zh: 我在你眼睛里看见了我缺的那块。
lines.en: In your eyes I see the piece I am missing.

lines.zh: 你走路的样子，骨头一定很整齐。
lines.en: The way you walk, your bones must be neatly arranged.

lines.zh: 别笑，我的脸只剩一半。
lines.en: Do not smile; only half of my face remains.

lines.zh: 我把你的呼吸听成骨头的响。
lines.en: I mistake your breathing for the sound of bone.

lines.zh: 你带着铁，铁会先替我开门。
lines.en: You carry iron, and iron will open the door for me.

lines.zh: 疼，但疼只是骨头的回声。
lines.en: It hurts, but pain is only bone echoing.

lines.zh: 你打断了一根，我还有更多。
lines.en: You broke one; I have plenty more.

lines.zh: 这具身体不归我，随便砸。
lines.en: This body is not mine; smash it freely.

lines.zh: 我的碎骨会自己找回来。
lines.en: My broken pieces will crawl back on their own.

lines.zh: 你打得挺准，可惜我不能失血。
lines.en: Good aim, but I have no blood to lose.

lines.zh: 轻点，那些是我借来的。
lines.en: Careful, those were borrowed.

lines.zh: 我的惨叫是从别人的喉咙里借的。
lines.en: My scream is borrowed from another throat.

lines.zh: 砸碎我，你只是帮我分散。
lines.en: Shatter me and you only help me spread out.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少了一条腿，我记住你了。
lines.en: That cost me a leg, and I will remember you.

lines.zh: 我会重组，你却不会。
lines.en: I will reassemble; you will not.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，我吃自己的骨髓。
lines.en: Food is useless to me; I feed on my own marrow.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，像在喂一具空壳。
lines.en: You hold out bread as if feeding an empty shell.

lines.zh: 我张不开嘴，我的下颌早丢了。
lines.en: I cannot open my mouth; my jaw was lost long ago.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我只想要你的骨头。
lines.en: Put it away; I only want the bones inside you.

lines.zh: 诱惑是对有胃的东西说的。
lines.en: Temptation is for creatures that still have stomachs.

lines.zh: 你拿肉引我，我闻到的却是铁。
lines.en: You wave meat at me, but I smell only iron.

lines.zh: 我嘴里空着，嚼不出你的心意。
lines.en: My mouth is empty, so I cannot chew your goodwill.

lines.zh: 别晃了，那东西在我眼里是石头。
lines.en: Stop waving it; in my eyes that thing is a stone.

lines.zh: 我追的不是食物，是会跑的身体。
lines.en: I chase no food, only bodies that still run.

lines.zh: 把面包留着垫你的坟。
lines.en: Keep the bread to pad your own grave.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，碎的是你的肩。
lines.en: You bumped into me, and the sound was your shoulder.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头，声音很清脆。
lines.en: Bone meets bone, and the sound is crisp.

lines.zh: 别推，我的零件经不起搬动。
lines.en: Do not shove; my parts do not survive being moved.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，一根肋骨留给你。
lines.en: I step aside and leave you one of my ribs.

lines.zh: 这具身子是拼的，撞一下会散。
lines.en: This body is pieced together; one hit scatters it.

lines.zh: 你挤过来时，我听见谁在磨牙。
lines.en: When you push in, I hear someone grinding teeth.

lines.zh: 慢点，你把我的第二副骨架踢歪了。
lines.en: Easy, you knocked my second skeleton crooked.

lines.zh: 我没有肉垫，所以每次相撞都很诚实。
lines.en: I have no padding, so every collision is honest.

lines.zh: 撞开我，后面还有三具。
lines.en: Shove me aside; three more stand behind me.

lines.zh: 你的重量压得我胫骨发响。
lines.en: Your weight makes my shin bone creak.

lines.zh: 我不会繁殖，我只会收集。
lines.en: I do not breed; I only collect.

lines.zh: 同族见面，我们交换一根骨头。
lines.en: When kin meet, we trade a single bone.

lines.zh: 没有血肉，就没有那种事。
lines.en: Without flesh, there is no such thing for us.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是一具还没拼完的架子。
lines.en: My mate is a frame I have not finished building.

lines.zh: 别在我面前提后代，我只有零件。
lines.en: Do not speak of offspring; I own only parts.

lines.zh: 两堆骨头靠在一起，也只是骨头。
lines.en: Two piles of bone leaning together are still bone.

lines.zh: 我们互相打量，看谁更完整。
lines.en: We size each other up, seeing who is more complete.

lines.zh: 传说维度不需要我们生，只要我们站着。
lines.en: The Legend realm needs us standing, not breeding.

lines.zh: 我拼过一具同伴，它第二天就散了。
lines.en: I built a companion once; it fell apart by morning.

lines.zh: 亲近对我们来说，就是共享骨髓。
lines.en: For us, closeness simply means sharing marrow.

lines.zh: 这根骨头不错，我收进胸腔。
lines.en: A fine bone; I tuck it into my ribcage.

lines.zh: 地上有根指骨，正好补我的左手。
lines.en: A finger bone on the ground fits my left hand.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，它就成了我的一部分。
lines.en: I pick it up, and it becomes part of me.

lines.zh: 铁片我不要，我只挑骨头。
lines.en: I leave the iron scraps; I only take bones.

lines.zh: 谁掉的东西，我都当成遗赠。
lines.en: Whatever falls, I treat as a bequest.

lines.zh: 这根太短，但可以垫在脚底。
lines.en: This one is short, but it can go under my foot.

lines.zh: 拾骨的时候，我会安静一会儿。
lines.en: While gathering bones, I am quiet for a moment.

lines.zh: 口袋对我无用，我塞进肋骨缝。
lines.en: Pockets are useless to me; I wedge it between ribs.

lines.zh: 那枚头骨有裂纹，只能当装饰。
lines.en: That skull is cracked, so it is only decoration.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的掉落物，等你来取。
lines.en: I pick up what you dropped and wait for you.

lines.zh: 三十二格外，我就闻到了你的骨气。
lines.en: Thirty-two blocks out, I smell the bone in you.

lines.zh: 你走进我的范围，就别再走了。
lines.en: You entered my range, so you stop here.

lines.zh: 目标确认，一副完整的骨架。
lines.en: Target confirmed: one fully assembled skeleton.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，我的关节开始响。
lines.en: I see you, and my joints begin to rattle.

lines.zh: 不用藏，骨头在暗处也发白。
lines.en: No use hiding; bone glows pale in the dark.

lines.zh: 你是我今晚要拆的那具。
lines.en: You are the one I take apart tonight.

lines.zh: 脚步声出卖了你，太整齐了。
lines.en: Your footsteps betray you; they are too orderly.

lines.zh: 我数三下，第三下你就得跑。
lines.en: I count three times; on the third you must run.

lines.zh: 又一个会走路的骨头架子来了。
lines.en: Another walking frame of bones has arrived.

lines.zh: 别回头，我已经在你背后。
lines.en: Do not look back; I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝虽然空，却锁得很准。
lines.en: Empty as they are, my sockets lock on true.

lines.zh: 传说维度的规矩：先看见的先拆。
lines.en: Legend realm rule: whoever sees first dismantles first.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，像新磨的骨粉。
lines.en: You smell like freshly ground bone dust.

lines.zh: 锁定。现在开始，你只能跑。
lines.en: Locked. From this moment, running is all you can do.

lines.zh: 你的骨架在响，我听见了。
lines.en: Your bones creak, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 又是活人，又得拆一遍。
lines.en: Another living thing. Another one to take apart.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，一步一步，不着急。
lines.en: I follow you step by step, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的肋骨就往左。
lines.en: You go left, and my ribs turn left with you.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我的腿比看上去耐用。
lines.en: Run; my legs last longer than they look.

lines.zh: 转弯没用，我从来不绕远。
lines.en: Turning will not help; I never take the long way.

lines.zh: 你停下来喘气，我就再近一步。
lines.en: When you stop to breathe, I gain another step.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里最好拆。
lines.en: I watch your knees; they come apart most easily.

lines.zh: 别爬高，我的手指会钩住石头。
lines.en: Do not climb; my fingers hook into stone.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我就把树也数上。
lines.en: Hide behind a tree, and I count the tree too.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离，我一直在量。
lines.en: I keep measuring the distance between us.

lines.zh: 传说维度的骨头，不会累。
lines.en: Bones from Precasia never tire.

lines.zh: 我的头一直朝着你，转不回来。
lines.en: My head stays pointed at you and will not turn back.

lines.zh: 这附近没有别人，只有你和我。
lines.en: Nobody else is near; there is only you and me.

lines.zh: 你压弯的草，替我标了方向。
lines.en: The grass you bent marks the direction for me.

lines.zh: 别以为影子能骗过我，我只有影子。
lines.en: Do not think shadows fool me; I am one.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，骨头一路响。
lines.en: I shuffle closer, bones rattling with each step.

lines.zh: 你想爬坡，坡上只有石头。
lines.en: You run uphill, and uphill is nothing but stone.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟抬得太高了。
lines.en: You lift your heels too high.

lines.zh: 我不躲，铁打在我肋骨上也一样。
lines.en: I do not dodge. Iron on my ribs changes nothing.

lines.zh: 这具身体早就该散了，可它不散。
lines.en: This body should have fallen apart long ago, yet it holds.

lines.zh: 你绕了一大圈，我还在原地等。
lines.en: You circled wide, and I am still waiting here.

lines.zh: 这一下九点五，够你记一阵。
lines.en: This blow lands nine and a half; remember it.

lines.zh: 我的指骨插进你的护甲缝。
lines.en: My finger bones slide into your armor's gaps.

lines.zh: 别挡，骨头撞铁只会更疼。
lines.en: Do not block; bone on iron only hurts more.

lines.zh: 我把你的盾推开，再拆肩膀。
lines.en: I shove your shield aside, then take the shoulder.

lines.zh: 你听见咔的一声，那是你自己的。
lines.en: You heard a crack; that one was yours.

lines.zh: 我不换手，我用两只断臂一起砸。
lines.en: I do not switch hands; both broken arms strike together.

lines.zh: 倒下吧，你的骨架我留全的。
lines.en: Fall now, and I will keep your skeleton whole.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着三具身体的重量。
lines.en: This punch carries the weight of three bodies.

lines.zh: 我打你的时候，自己的骨头也在响。
lines.en: When I strike you, my own bones rattle too.

lines.zh: 你的血溅到我的肋骨上，很暖。
lines.en: Your blood on my ribs is warm for a moment.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，我全身都是。
lines.en: I need no weapon; my whole body is one.

lines.zh: 再近一寸，你的锁骨就归我。
lines.en: One inch closer and your collarbone is mine.

lines.zh: 别急着死，我还没拆完。
lines.en: Do not die yet; I have not finished taking you apart.

lines.zh: 你退后也没用，我的手臂更长。
lines.en: Backing away will not help; my arms reach farther.

lines.zh: 肘骨撞上你的下巴，很响。
lines.en: My elbow bone meets your jaw, loudly.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，用力一扯。
lines.en: I grab your collar and wrench.

lines.zh: 这一下带着骨粉的味道。
lines.en: This blow carries the smell of bone dust.

lines.zh: 你听见的响声，是我自己的关节。
lines.en: That crack you heard was my own joint.

lines.zh: 我把你的护腕往里掰。
lines.en: I bend your bracer inward.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我要歇一歇。
lines.en: After this one, I need a moment.

lines.zh: 我从传说维度的土里把自己拼起来。
lines.en: I assemble myself out of the Legend realm's soil.

lines.zh: 谁把这么多骨头扔在一处？
lines.en: Who left so many bones piled in one place?

lines.zh: 关节归位，现在轮到你们了。
lines.en: My joints are set; now it is your turn.

lines.zh: 我又回来了，少了两根手指。
lines.en: I am back again, short two fingers.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是我原来的，但够用。
lines.en: This body is not my old one, but it will do.

lines.zh: 光太亮，我的骨架在发抖。
lines.en: The light is too bright; my frame is shivering.

lines.zh: 地底下有人在数骨头，数到了我。
lines.en: Something underground counted bones and counted me.

lines.zh: 站起来，先找最近的心跳。
lines.en: Stand up, then find the nearest heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，是尘土。
lines.en: My first breath is nothing but dust.

lines.zh: 传说维度又吐出我一个。
lines.en: The Legend realm has spat me out once more.

lines.zh: 拼装完成，膝盖还是反的。
lines.en: Assembly complete, though my knees are still backwards.

lines.zh: 我刚醒，就已经饿了。
lines.en: I just woke up, and I am already hungry.

lines.zh: 火在烧我，骨髓却点不着。
lines.en: The fire burns, but my marrow will not light.

lines.zh: 落地时我听到自己散了一半。
lines.en: On landing I hear half of me scatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进胸腔，从肋骨缝里漏出去了。
lines.en: Water fills my chest and leaks out between ribs.

lines.zh: 炸开也好，省得我自己拆。
lines.en: Blow me apart; it saves me the dismantling.

lines.zh: 箭插在骨缝里，正好当钉子。
lines.en: The arrow sits in a joint, a fine new nail.

lines.zh: 魔法烫进骨头，像有人在我体内点燃。
lines.en: Magic sears into bone, like fire lit inside me.

lines.zh: 我早就不吃东西了，饿只是习惯。
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago; hunger is only habit.

lines.zh: 雷把我照亮，我好看清你的位置。
lines.en: Lightning lights me up so I can see where you are.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拆得比我自己还干净。
lines.en: The void takes me apart cleaner than I ever could.
